methods.name: CRT Emudriver + CRU + Special K
methods.summary: Working configuration for a 15 kHz consumer CRT using a custom 426×240 display mode.

utilities.name: CRU (Custom Resolution Utility)
utilities.role: Used to configure the exact 426×240 CRT display mode

utilities.name: Special K
utilities.role: Used to configure the game's display/fullscreen behavior

utilities.name: CRT Emudriver
utilities.role: Provides low-resolution CRT output on the supported Radeon

steps: Configure and verify a stable 426×240 custom mode at approximately 59.840 Hz on the CRT-connected Radeon using CRU.
Launch the game with Special K and configure its display/fullscreen behavior to use the CRT output.
Select the 426×240 mode where supported, then confirm the game renders on the CRT without unintended scaling or cropping.
If the game does not use the desired output, review the Windows display assignment and Special K configuration before changing CRT timings.
knownIssues: 426 pixels is not divisible by eight; the VMMaker exporter normally flags this mode for manual CRU review.
The community listing reports 426×240 at 60 Hz, while the maintainer's working CRU mode is approximately 59.840 Hz.
methods.sourceNote: Maintainer-tested setup; precise Special K menu values have not yet been documented.
